look_here_first: Rough leaf surface plus strongly raised netlike veins beneath; unarmed woody plant.
taxonomic_note: Current Kew POWO accepts Celtis reticulata as a species. Celtis laevigata var. reticulata is a homotypic synonym and the B091 source row is folded into this canonical species.

best_field_traits: lower surface with strongly raised netlike veins
margins entire or sparsely toothed above middle
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Compared with C. laevigata, netleaf hackberry has thicker rougher leaves and much more conspicuous reticulate venation beneath. C. lindheimeri differs by dense white tomentum on the leaf underside.
